Many believe and hope that it can once and forever get rid of all human sufferings due to diseases, disability, starvation, etc. On the other hand, more conservative and pessimistic people - who believe they are somewhat realistic, argue that genetic engineering will never be able to accomplish what it promises. Altering some organism's genes is thought to be against religious beliefs and values. It is also considered immoral to hybridise some organism for selfish human needs.
